title: Quenched Mustardy Saudi Brie Flatbread
description: A fluffy, mustardy flatbread crowned with melted brie and a hint of kombu extract, served sizzling on a comal for a show‑off Saudi‑Arabian splash of flavor.
instructions: Preheat a comal over medium heat until hot
Brush one side of each flatbread lightly with olive oil and place oily side down on the comal
Cook the flatbread for 1-2 minutes until golden brown and slightly crisp, flip and cook the other side for another minute
Spread a thin layer of dijon mustard over the cooked side of each flatbread
Top each mustard-coated flatbread with a slice of brie cheese
Drizzle kombu cold extract, lemon juice, and honey over the cheese, then sprinkle ground cumin and chopped coriander
Cover the flatbread with a lid or another skillet for 2 minutes to melt the brie slightly
Remove from heat, gently slide onto a serving plate, and slice into wedges
Serve warm with a side of fresh cucumber slices and a drizzle of extra olive oil if desired
